summary: Add dual upload storage: new uploads go to the configured primary backend (UPLOAD_STORAGE_BACKEND=fs|s3) while reads route per stored path (s3://<bucket>/<key> from a private S3-compatible bucket, other paths from the filesystem); add streaming UploadService.OpenReader, PresignGetURL and an authenticated GET /uploads/{id} download route. Compositions without a config Source must now also provide *uploadsconfig.StorageConfig.
